2193:   function normalizeAttributePosition(position) {
2194:     const raw = String(position || 'C').toUpperCase();
2195: 
2196:     if (raw === 'C' || raw.includes('CENTER')) return 'C';
2197:     if (raw === 'LW' || raw.includes('LEFT WING')) return 'LW';
2198:     if (raw === 'RW' || raw.includes('RIGHT WING')) return 'RW';
2199: 
2200:     if (
2201:       raw === 'D' ||
2202:       raw === 'LD' ||
2203:       raw.includes('LEFT DEFENSE') ||
2204:       raw.includes('DEFENSEMAN')
2205:     ) {
